BongoCat needs administrator access to keep receiving keyboard and mouse input when another app is running with administrator privileges.

To set it up: right-click BongoCat → Properties → Compatibility → turn on "Run this program as an administrator".

attribute.root_desc: Constitution: +8 inner force and +2 aptitude a point. Aptitude is what makes 功法 learn faster and fail less. Pairs with Mana in the spell school (+15 spell power a point, plus 10 for the shorter half).
attribute.strength_desc: Strength: +3 attack and +20 health a point. Pairs with Agility in the martial school (+20 martial power a point, plus 10 for the shorter half).
attribute.mana_desc: Mana: +3 spell power and +2 spell resist a point. Pairs with Constitution in the spell school (+20 spell power a point, plus 10 for the shorter half).
attribute.agility_desc: Agility: +2 speed, +10 hit and +10 evade a point. Pairs with Strength in the martial school (+12 martial power a point, plus 10 for the shorter half). Hit against the other side's evade decides the chance: even is about eighty percent, a two-to-one gap about fifty.

hint.derived_title: The eight combat numbers: what the four attributes turn into, not points you can spend
hint.derived_hint_each: Read off the four attributes above; only changing those moves this.
hint.power_hint: Power = spell + martial, and it is the number that decides a breakthrough.
hint.aptitude_hint: Aptitude sets how reliably and how fast arts are learned — 50% (黄) / 42% (玄) / 35% (地) / 20% (天) / 5% (神) at zero, and each point multiplies the rate by 1.01 and the cost by 0.99. It joins no fight.

daily.ambush: Ambushed at dawn — the attacker was driven off
daily.ambush_lost: Ambushed at dawn — driven back, and nothing lost
daily.trinket: A quiet morning, and a few coins in the dust

level.rule: Cumulative level = (realm position − 1) × 100 + layer × 10 + rank, layers counted from 0. Ten realms × one hundred levels = one thousand.

cultivation.aptitude_hint: Aptitude sets how reliably and how fast arts are learned: at 0 an attempt succeeds 50% (yellow) / 42% (profound) / 35% (earth) / 20% (heaven) / 5% (divine) and a rank costs three times the printed pomodoros; each point multiplies the rate by 1.01 and the cost by 0.99 (a fraction up to 0.2 rounds down, above it rounds up). Every hundred needs a Marrow Pill before it can move again. Ten arts — two per grade — are written for it: each rank they take adds 0.2 to 2.0 points by grade.

proving.title: Trial
proving.hint: Every finished pomodoro earns one trial chance, ten at most. A trial is fought at home: a walk you have not returned from closes it. The opponent is levelled to you, and a win pays loot at the base chances — a seed most often, gear sometimes, an art almost never.
proving.lost: The trial was too much; nothing came of it.
proving.refuse_empty: No trial chance banked: finish a pomodoro to earn one
proving.refuse_out: Still out on a walk — a trial waits until you are home
